newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt again extends deadline of battery firm sale.
newsitem.headline: Egypt again extends deadline of battery firm sale.

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Chemical Industries has extended again the deadline for bids to buy a 38 percent stake in batteries firm Chloride Egypt until March 16, sources close to the deal said on Tuesday.
The original deadline was January 16 but was moved to February 3 at the request of some investors, the parent company said in a published advertisement.
"The decision was taken because of (short working hours in) the fasting month of Ramadan and the feast holiday,"one of the sources told Reuters.
Last month, the state offered for auction the 38 percent or 34,200 shares to one or more strategic investor.
Chloride Egypt has a capital of nine million pounds ($2.6 million). It manufactures automotive and industrial batteries.
An Arab investor owns 52 percent of the firm and the American University's Investment Fund owns the remaining 10 percent, the agents of the sale have said.
The Arab investor had bought the stake from British firm Chloride Plc, they added.
